name: Star Toggle
description: Favorite toggle where a cartoon star jumps out of a portal hole, morphs round, flips its face from sad to happy and lands back, with a spin and squash.
contents: Small star with eyes and a mouth on a centered stage
Portal hole at the base of the star
behavior: Click runs a GSAP keyframe jump, squash, spin and face change, then flips the checked state
Clicks are ignored while the animation is running
Calls onChange with the new boolean state
Press scales the icon down slightly
editableByProps: Initial state, change callback and accessible label
Stage, star, face, active and portal hole colors
fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Star, hole and face internal dimensions are fixed pixel values and only scale through the size prop wrapper
